newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas untraded on quiet Friday afternoon.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas untraded on quiet Friday afternoon.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Friday afternoon after a relatively busy morning session.
The morning had seen 200 lots traded in eight separate months, all at sharply higher prices as futures caught up with the recent strength on the physical market.

But activity completely died after lunch, and no further deals were struck. Even so, the day was among the busiest of the week, with 230 lots done on Thursday but only 50 on Wednesday and 20 on Tuesday. A total of 23 deals were done in the week, most following the upswing in physical prices on Thursday afternoon.
